name: Shed Ramp Angle Calculator
description: Calculate shed ramp angle, slope, rise-to-run ratio and ramp length.
search_intent: Find the ramp angle and required length for a shed, mower or equipment ramp.
calculation: Angle degrees = atan(rise/run) converted to degrees when run > 0. Slope percent = rise/run × 100. Ramp length = sqrt(rise² + run²). Rise-to-run ratio should be normalized as approximately 1 : run/rise when rise > 0. Preserve units consistently.
limitations: This is a geometry calculator, not an accessibility or building-code compliance checker.
Safe ramp slope depends on intended equipment, surface traction and local requirements.
Very steep ramps can be unsafe even if geometrically valid.
